_meta.name: godot
_meta.description: Godot Engine MCP — lets agents interact with the Godot editor (create scenes, add nodes, run projects).

env_vars.GODOT_PATH: Absolute path to the Godot executable — set as system env var

_meta.note: Uses direct node invocation — set GODOT_MCP_NODE and GODOT_MCP_SCRIPT if using fnm/nvm. Otherwise npx works if package is globally installed.
